# Workik

> > Workik is an AI-powered code generation and automation platform that accelerates development across multiple languages, frameworks, and cloud infrastructure with context-driven assistance.

Workik integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and popular IDEs to provide intelligent code generation, testing, database optimization, and CI/CD automation. The platform supports JavaScript, Python, TypeScript, PHP, and more, with specialized generators for frameworks like Ember.js, Laravel, Spring Boot, and cloud infrastructure tools like AWS CDK.

## Key Topics

- AI Code Generation
- Context-Driven Development
- Multi-Language Support (JavaScript, Python, TypeScript, PHP)
- GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket Integration
- Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK)
- Database Optimization (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
- CI/CD Automation
- Test Generation (JUnit)
- Data Pipeline Development (PySpark)
- API Integration
- Code Automation
- Deployment Automation
- Team Collaboration
- Web Application Security (CSRF Protection)
- Framework Support (Ember.js, Laravel, Spring Boot)
